summary.text: George Miller is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates, representing District 90, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Ballotpedia lists his tenure as beginning in 2020 and his profession as supervisor.

paragraphs.text: George Miller was born in East Stroudsburg, Pennsylvania, lives in West Virginia, and has worked as a supervisor.
Miller has represented District 90 since December 1, 2022, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
In the 2023-2024 session he was vice chairman of the Agriculture and Natural Resources Committee, according to Ballotpedia.
